merchantRtp.title: Merchant RTP Control V2
merchantRtp.featureSingleOrAllGames: ✅ Control RTP for a single game or all games
merchantRtp.hgRtpFeedback: HG: RTP options match whitelist, max 97
merchantRtp.agRtpFeedback: Note: AG supports RTP values 0 and 10–97
merchantRtp.maxMultiplePlaceholder: Leave empty for default 100; if not 0, range is 1–10000
merchantRtp.maxWinPlaceholder: Leave empty for default 1000000; if not 0, range is 1–100000000
merchantRtp.searchGamesPlaceholder: Search and select games (multi-select), or choose ALL
merchantRtp.gamesFeedback: Select multiple games, or ALL to apply to all slot games

conditionalRtp.bulletFirstMatch: ✅ First-Match: the first matching rule from top to bottom takes effect
conditionalRtp.bulletRuleTypes: ✅ Rule types: deposit only / activity claim only / deposit-principal loss only (each rule is independent)
conditionalRtp.bulletConditions: ✅ Supported conditions: no deposit / deposit amount threshold, optional historical activity rewards > threshold, deposit-principal loss >= threshold (excludes bonus losses), game scope
conditionalRtp.bulletSaveLoad: ✅ Supports saving/loading backend conditional RTP config (demo integration)
conditionalRtp.bulletHgCancel: ✅ HG optional cancel RTP: hgPlayerAction cancelRtp in rule; auto-calls vendor /api/v2/player/cancelRtp on registration/deposit match (no manual BO)
conditionalRtp.bulletDualVendor: ✅ AG + HG together: saved as applyVendors; auto-apply calls both vendors in order (dual-vendor RTP must satisfy AG and HG set rules)
conditionalRtp.ruleTypeFeedback: Each rule does one thing: deposit only, activity claim total only, or deposit-principal loss only.
conditionalRtp.lossMinAmountPlaceholder: e.g. 500 — loss = max(0, deposits - withdrawals - balance); bonus losses excluded
conditionalRtp.lossMinAmountFeedback: Evaluated after bets/withdrawals. Only deposit-funded loss counts; reward balance does not.
conditionalRtp.activityIdsPlaceholder: Multi-select activities (both threshold below required to take effect)
conditionalRtp.activityRewardPlaceholder: User historical total claimed in these activities must be strictly greater than this amount
conditionalRtp.activityRewardFeedback: Summed from promotion activity_rewards: all issued records per user per activity (multi-activity sums combined). Claim success triggers conditional RTP re-evaluation.
conditionalRtp.rtpFeedbackDual: Dual vendor: must be in AG (0 or 10–97) and HG whitelist
conditionalRtp.rtpFeedbackHg: HG whitelist tiers; permissions may limit supported range
conditionalRtp.gameScopeFeedback: ALL means all slots; max 50 gameids per batch. HG cancel RTP also needs gameid list
conditionalRtp.noRulesHint: Use the form above to add the first rule
